muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events sse(Stream(ctx, send))" -}}
{{- with .Event "news" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- with .ID "42" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- with .Retry 3000 -}}{{- end -}}
{{- .Result -}}
{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Stream emits one event; the template's .Event/.ID/.Retry setters become the
// event:, id:, and retry: wire lines an sse-swap style listener selects on.
func (Server) Stream(ctx context.Context, send func(string) error) {
	_ = send("hello")
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	for _, want := range []string{"event: news\n", "id: 42\n", "retry: 3000\n", "data: hello\n\n"} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the wire line %q", body, want)
		}
	}
}
